cards.t: Initia Halts Network After Exploit and Unauthorized Token Minting
cards.b: Initia halted its layer-1 network and rollups following a security incident involving unauthorized token minting and millions in asset transfers.

per.INIT: Network operations have been suspended while security researchers and the team investigate the exploit.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total funds permanently lost and exact timeline for network restart.

cards.t: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Hoodi Testnet Launch Over Security Flaws
cards.b: Ethereum developers canceled the Hoodi testnet activation for the Glamsterdam upgrade after security researchers identified gas rule flaws that could affect smart contracts.

per.ETH: Testnet upgrade timeline is pushed back while gas rules and code safety are reviewed.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: New reschedule date for the Hoodi testnet fork.

cards.t: Switzerland Approves First Retail Spot Bitcoin ETF for November Launch
cards.b: FINMA has cleared Switzerland's first retail spot Bitcoin ETF by BIT Asset Management, which is scheduled to list on the SIX Swiss Exchange in November.

per.BTC: Will have a new regulated retail investment product vehicle available on the Swiss market.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Cardano Treasury Proposal Requests 22M ADA for Tokenized Copper Bet
cards.b: Toto Finance has asked Cardano holders to allocate 22 million ADA from the network's treasury to purchase tokenized copper.

per.ADA: A successful vote would commit a significant portion of treasury funds into a commodity-backed token investment.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Whether the community vote passes and the final execution timeline.

cards.t: Bitwise Dogecoin ETF Reaches Scheduled Liquidation
cards.b: The Bitwise Dogecoin ETF has reached its scheduled liquidation less than a year after launch, leaving holders facing cash redemptions.

per.DOGE: The investment product is winding down, forcing asset liquidations and cash returns to holders.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Final payout values and exact completion date of distributions.
